goals.0: Understanding common questions: Stärken, Schwächen, Motivation
goals.2: Presenting yourself in an organised way
goals.3: Asking back: Wie sieht die Einarbeitung aus?
grammar.0.note: Be honest in the interview, but when you mention a weakness also say how you manage it. Asking a question at the end shows interest.
grammar.1.note: Konjunktiv II = polite, possible or hypothetical. Use the A2 auxiliaries (hätte, wäre, könnte, würde) in every sentence here.
grammar.2.note: Etiquette differs between cultures; in Germany punctuality and direct eye contact are seen as positive.
quiz.1.why: die Einarbeitung = induction into a new job.
quiz.4.prompt: „Wann könnten Sie anfangen?“ — which answer is polite?
quiz.8.prompt: What is good at the end of an interview?
quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “I want to take on responsibility.”
quiz.9.why: Modal verb 2nd, infinitive at the end.
